facts.fact: MACRA, at the High Court Zomba District Registry's request, issued an expression of interest for consultants to develop a court case management system, to be piloted at the registry before adoption, with e-filing, scheduling, case tracking and a public portal in scope.
facts.system: Court Case Management System for the Zomba High Court

facts.fact: The tender states that all court records are currently managed manually and that an earlier automation effort relying on servers at the Blantyre Principal Registry was unsuccessful.
facts.system: Court records at the Zomba High Court

systems.system: Court Case Management System for the Zomba High Court
systems.owner: High Court Zomba District Registry; MACRA procuring
